name: CI Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: macos-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install pytest ruff

    - name: Run pytest
      run: pytest

    - name: Run ruff
      run: ruff .

    - name: Check path consistency
      run: bash scripts/check-path-consistency.sh

    - name: Enhanced distribution checks
      run: bash scripts/verify-distribution.sh

    - name: Fix legacy Active/ path references
      run: sed -i '' 's|/Users/davekilleen/Active/|/path/to/new/active/folder/|g' work_server.py
